name: ibkr-mcp-guard
description: Unofficial guarded connector to Interactive Brokers' official MCP server: read accounts, positions and market data, manage alerts and watchlists, and create order drafts. Never submits orders.

interface.shortDescription: Read your IBKR account and draft orders — never submits
interface.longDescription: Connects to Interactive Brokers' official MCP server through a local safety guard. You sign in once in your browser. Your assistant can then read balances, positions, orders, trades, quotes, price history, option chains and research, manage alerts and watchlists, and create order drafts (order instructions) that you review and approve yourself inside IBKR. Tools that place, submit or transmit orders are removed, and the order-submission permission is never requested. Tokens stay on your computer (macOS Keychain or a private file). Unofficial; not affiliated with Interactive Brokers. Not financial advice.
defaultPrompt: What are my IBKR positions and today's P&L?
Show my account balances and buying power
Draft a limit order to buy 10 AAPL at 180 (draft only)
